dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCHCM34 is part of the ORCA online receipt accounting card subsystem.
evidence: COPY CPSRYACCT.INC, CPCOMMONPRT.INC, CPASGNPARA.INC etc. (ORCA-specific copybooks)

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (shinryo-kaikei) processing — accounting card (kaikei card) generation for inpatient/outpatient billing under the JMA ORCA system
purpose.summary: ORCHCM34 generates accounting card output (kaikei card) for the ORCA medical receipt system. It reads diagnosis-act accounting files and procedure-act files, processes insurance combination data, and produces printed output for medical billing. It handles inpatient/outpatient billing, rehabilitation, self-pay, and various insurance category distinctions.

notable_features: 64 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPSRYACCT.INC, CPSRYACT.INC, CPCOMMONPRT.INC, etc.)
INDEXED file with DYNAMIC access mode
Large working-storage with extensive flag, counter, and index areas
626 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: File is 355KB / 8472 lines — a large production program. Comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding, rendered as garbled latin-1 in this context. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Truncated at 16000 chars but structural indicators confirm full COBOL program with all four divisions.
